items.title: MCP Servers Explained & Built
items.description: Secure your MCP server using Descope for free: https://www.descope.com/ MCP servers are quickly becoming one of the most important pieces of the AI ecosystem. But what actually happens behind the scenes? In this video, I break down MCP servers from the ground up and then build one from scratch. We’ll cover what MCP is, how local and remote servers differ, how access control works, and how the MCP protocol connects AI models to external tools and data. Then we’ll put it all together by building an MCP server and adding authentication so you can see how these systems work in practice. If you’re building AI agents or want to understand how AI connects to real-world tools, this is a great place to start. Want to LEARN how to build useful AI agents that actually get things done? items.title: AI has made writing code cheap
items.description: What are developers actually hired for now that AI writes the code? Not typing speed, and not churning out boilerplate, that was the old junior job, and it's the part AI replaced. The skill that pays in 2026 is system understanding: reading an architecture, predicting what breaks when you change something, and knowing how the data flows between the pieces. Code got cheap. Judgment about the system didn't. #techwithtim #softwareengineering #techjobs

items.title: How to Use AI Agents in YOUR Telegram (Mira AI Guide)
items.description: Try Mira for free 👉 https://t.me/mira?start=aitrendz The next AI era is not about tools. It's about directing AI agents from a single chat. Mira lets you do exactly that inside Telegram. No complicated setups or jumping between tools. Just one chat. You can set up recurring tasks like Bitcoin price alerts or daily news updates, access multiple LLMs, image, video, and music models all in one place, and even add Mira into your team group chats to collaborate. Use skills for repetitive workflows and let it handle the heavy lifting. Instead of doing everything yourself with AI, you tell Mira your goal and it figures things out on its own. This is where I believe we're heading. It's on Telegram now and coming to iMessage and Slack soon! Try it for free and comment your favorite use case below. Follow me for more AI breakdowns. #Mira #AIAgents #AITutorial #Telegram #AIAgent

items.title: Building AI Assistants with On-Device Memory
items.description: Learn More: https://bit.ly/4AlVW2n A cloud-based assistant can remember what it sees, hears, and is told, but only by staying connected and sending that data to a remote server. In our new short course, Building AI Assistants with On-Device Memory, built in partnership with Qdrant and taught by Dylan Couzon, Developer Experience Engineer at Qdrant, you'll learn to store and search an assistant's memories locally, so nothing has to leave the device. In this course, you'll learn how to: - Build a local memory system that stores, retrieves, filters, and forgets text and image memories. - Build an offline assistant that recalls experiences across text, voice, and images. - Teach an AI application to recognize new objects from stored examples without retraining a model. - Run the on-device AI assistant on a local machine, including Mac, Windows, and Linux. This course also includes our new AI coding lab, so you can practice building with an AI coding agent from the DeepLearning.AI mobile app. Enroll Now:https://bit.ly/4AlVW2n

items.title: Full Course: Spec-Driven Development with Coding Agents
items.description: Vibe coding is fast, but it often produces code that doesn't match what you asked for. Spec-driven development is the disciplined alternative: write a clear markdown spec defining what to build, and let your coding agent implement it. Earn your certificate here: https://bit.ly/4hmJc2K You'll learn to: - Write a project constitution defining mission, tech stack, and roadmap - Plan, implement, and validate features using a spec as the agent's guide - Introduce SDD to a legacy codebase - Package your workflow into an agent skill that's portable across agents and IDEs Spec-Driven Development with Coding Agents is built in partnership with JetBrains and taught by Paul Everitt, Developer Advocate at JetBrains. Recommended: basic familiarity with a programming language and experience with LLM-based coding tools.

items.description: Scientists just discovered a new wild cat species and the internet is going insane 🐈 Meet the Tilcayo tiger cat newly! It’s small, elusive, and has been hiding from humans this entire time. New species discoveries like this are becoming more common as AI-assisted field research and satellite tracking reach places humans never could before. The wild is still full of things we haven’t found yet. When I saw a viral video by @fatiihh.shn of his cat, I had to make this with the new cat spieces 🐱 credit to @fatiihh.shn on IG for this amazing idea! Wdyt? Is it cute or scary?
